notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four lands.
description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Avenger of Zendikar.
When the Avenger of Zendikar tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating at least twenty 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, Orthion triggers, causing you to sacrfiice the Avenger of Zendikar tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.
